maintenance_led.reason: Mainly sells new scissors, rulers, first aid kits and sharpeners to schools, offices and businesses; kit refills are a minor share.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are retailers, businesses, consumers and distributors buying first aid, cutting and measuring products; government is a minor buyer.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by selling its own brands (Westcott, First Aid Only); acquisitions like Med-Nap and Spill Magic are occasional.

mission_critical.reason: Scissors, rulers, first aid kits and sharpeners are largely standard consumer and supply products that retailers can swap easily.
